name: dev-pipeline
description: A 5-phase development pipeline (requirement engineering, system architecture, task generation, verified implementation, code review) with an optional QA gate (plan-qa + execute-qa) for changes that have a running surface worth driving — independent of /review, run sequentially or in parallel at the developer's discretion — plus supporting skills for branch bootstrap, worktree lanes, issue archival, release notes, session stats, session cost tracking, and conventional commits
